newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Petronas says Syria field oil flow in two months.
newsitem.headline: Petronas says Syria field oil flow in two months.

text.p: Malaysia national oil firm Petronas' said on Tuesday it expected its first production from its jointly owned Syria oil field within the next two months.
"Oil will start flowing within the next couple of months," president and chief excutive officer Hassan Marican told Reuters on the sidelines of an oil and gas conference.
The oil field is jointly owned by Petronas, France Elf Acquintaine and Japan's Sumitomo Corp.
The exploration contract, which covers a 4,200 square km concession in the northeast of Syria, was signed with the government of Syria in January this year.
Elf holds a 40 percent stake, Sumitomo and Petronas each have 30 percent in the joint venture.
